about: Budgets for scripts/perf-measure.sh, compared by scripts/perf-budget.py in the Performance budget job (#853). Every metric is lower-is-better. baseline is the number a budget was set from; budget is the most a pull request may measure. Raising a budget is a reviewed change: say why in the pull request. Baselines come from the GitHub runners in CI run 44526599102. Image sizes get 10%. Startup varies between runs, so its budget is about twice the number seen, rounded up to a whole second. Memory gets one and a half times. Image sizes are read from the layers of the saved image, so the image store does not change them. Sizes are MB, startup is seconds, memory is the console's resident MB after 60 s idle.
